algorithm: {The proposed algorithm is a hybrid of Simulated Annealing (SA) and Differential Evolution (DE), which exploits the global optimization capabilities of DE with the robustness of SA to handle multimodal landscapes like the Rosenbrock function.}
{A stochastic iterative optimization algorithm that combines a perturbation-based initialization with a sequence of Gaussian random walk and recombination steps to find the global optimum.}
